sentences.l2: 10代の男の子が、はじめてたくさんの観客の前で、ギターのソロを演奏しました。
sentences.l1: A boy in his 10s performed a guitar solo in front of a large audience for the first time.

sentences.l2: 手がふるえましたが、大きく息をすって、ゆっくりひきました。
sentences.l1: His hands trembled, but he took a deep breath and played slowly.

sentences.l2: さいごに、みんながたくさん拍手をしてくれました。
sentences.l1: At the end, everyone applauded a lot for him.
